infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SIAB uses the camera so you can photograph products you are listing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SIAB needs access to your photos so you can add pictures to listings and messages.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SIAB uses your location only when you choose to share it in a message or set your stall location. It never tracks you in the background.
